The terminal is an independently supplied furniture component deliberately uncoated but fully shaped and surface-prepared for its declared connection interface, with downstream finishing/furniture assembly outside this terminal. It is not a rough blank, bundle of round rods or complete furniture. `richman-unfinished-leg` establishes individually sold unfinished surface-prepared solid turned legs and an inserted-connector example; `drewbak-components` establishes industrial beech component machining and drawing/finished-component quality context; `bukexpo-beech-supply` supplie

Exclude tool handles/ornaments, raw sawnwood/unshaped billets, laminated/finger-jointed/glued or bentwood, heat-densified/preserved stock, coated/oiled/waxed legs, onsite log conversion/kiln drying/glue or coating mixing, whole chairs/tables/cabinets, complete flat-pack kits and installed furniture. Actual coating or bonding is not a hidden zero operation: first extend evidence, materials, energy, reactions/emissions and finished acceptance boundary. Surface preparation in this bounded route is actual dry sanding; no glue or coating is invented. Supplier forestry, sawing, drying and article manufacturing burdens remain upstream in the product system.

This is a declared production quantity, with no mass-equivalent function, furniture lifetime, load/strength threshold, dimension, moisture target, density, speed, temperature/time, dosage, yield or certification default. Actual packaging/storage/handling/dispatch/returns have a separate service account for observed H and original cohort Q_H. findings.summary: The defined exhaustive P/I/ER receipt partition omits a first standalone non-purchased packaging article.
findings.counterexample: Opening stock=0. Receive a first standalone gift/borrow/pool whole packaging article compatible with this actual pool (20 kg measured wet lot), with no paid-goods acquisition, no supplier-accompanied material and no earlier outward event. Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg. It cannot be invented as an old return or repaired by a moisture/repair residual.
findings.expected_repair: Make actual paid whole-article receipts P (including proven bundled paid goods); make I a disjoint actual first non-purchased receipt, explicitly including borrowed/gift/pool and supplier-included cases that are not P; ER needs the same article earlier outward history. Update headings/cards/protocol fields and normative rules in both languages. Preserve full gross mass, wet stocks, original cohort/H, inherited service and one actual burden owner; no fresh manufacture burden solely because ownership changes.
